data.name: Boomitra
data.description: Boomitra is a US-headquartered carbon removal project developer working with farmers and ranchers across Latin America, Africa and Asia on soil carbon and grassland restoration, pioneering Verra-approved remote-sensing/AI MRV for soil organic carbon. The company won the 2023 Earthshot Prize and in 2025 issued a record 3.03 million Verra VM0042 soil-carbon removal credits from its Northern Mexico Grassland Restoration Project, while also expanding into biomass carbon removal and storage (BiCRS) via its Oasis project in Botswana.
